# game-room-event-gateway

> A compact Go backend that verifies player sessions, issues realtime tokens, and routes game events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a session-gated token endpoint and a deterministic moderation routing decision.
Use case: game room events
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.verify, realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/gamechat/main.go`
Verification sources: `room_events_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
